fields.name: sei_url
fields.label: SEI address
fields.help: The SEI address without /sei at the end; use https, or http for localhost only. Changing it starts a new account whose first check announces nothing.

fields.name: sei_api_url
fields.label: mod-wssei API address
fields.help: Set it only when the monitor cannot discover the mod-wssei address by itself.

fields.name: sei_username
fields.label: SEI username
fields.help: Your SEI login. Changing it starts a new account whose first check announces nothing.

fields.name: sei_org
fields.label: Agency
fields.help: The agency acronym or numeric id, as the orgs command lists them. Changing it starts a new account whose first check announces nothing.

fields.name: sei_password
fields.label: SEI password
fields.help: Set this, the password file or the password command, and only one of them. Saving restarts the monitor, and with a valid password that is one login to SEI. A wrong password costs one rejected login and pauses the monitor until you request a check.

fields.name: sei_password_file
fields.label: SEI password file
fields.help: Path of a file that holds the password, read once at start-up.
fields.reason: It makes the monitor read a file inside the hub's container, so only the hub's .env sets it.

fields.name: sei_password_cmd
fields.label: SEI password command
fields.help: A command that prints the password, run at every login without a shell and with a 30-second limit.
fields.reason: It makes the monitor run a program inside the hub's container, so only the hub's .env sets it.

fields.name: sei_timezone
fields.label: Time zone
fields.help: The time zone of the dates SEI shows. Roraima uses America/Boa_Vista.

fields.name: sei_units
fields.label: Units
fields.help: Unit acronyms separated by commas, or all. Empty watches your current unit.

fields.name: poll_interval
fields.label: Check interval
fields.help: Time between checks, such as 15m or 1h. The minimum is 5m.

fields.name: sei_concurrency
fields.label: Simultaneous calls
fields.help: How many calls to SEI run at once, from 1 to 10.

fields.name: retention_days
fields.label: Retention (days)
fields.help: Days to keep events and the processes that left your units, up to 3650. Use at least the return warning plus 2, or 0 to keep everything.

fields.name: return_warning_days
fields.label: Return warning (days)
fields.help: How many days before a scheduled return to warn you, from 0 to 60.

fields.name: notification_detail
fields.label: Notification detail
fields.help: full adds the process type and description, the activity text and the document name to each event. Choose it only if that content may pass through the hub's channels.

fields.name: database_url
fields.label: Database address
fields.help: The monitor's Postgres, postgres://user:password@host/database, reached without TLS. Pointing it at another database leaves behind the record of a rejected login, so the next start tries the password again.

fields.name: database_url_file
fields.label: Database address file
fields.help: Path of a file that holds the database address, read once at start-up.
fields.reason: It makes the monitor read a file inside the hub's container, so only the hub's .env sets it.
